snippet.description:
Did you know bees can play? Recent research and videos show bees rolling wooden balls around in behavior that looks like play — and it’s delightful. But is this a sign of animal intelligence? On Vox’s Explain It to Me, we look into the concept of intelligence and how those judgments shape the way we treat the natural world.
